name: Foreign Military Entanglement and Intelligence Competition in the Horn
title: Djibouti · Foreign Military Entanglement and Intelligence Competition
situation: Sahel and Horn of Africa instability

definition.question: How intense is foreign military entanglement and intelligence competition in the Horn of Africa, centered on Djibouti?
definition.low_end: Minimal foreign military presence with routine logistics and no intelligence competition or interference between co-located forces.
definition.high_end: Dense co-location of rival bases engaged in active SIGINT interception, harassment (lasers, airspace denial), and operational interference forcing emissions-control and deconfliction failures.
